name: Inran Shinsatsushitsu
source: A female doctor with a stethoscope conducts strange medical examinations. She makes the man who came to see her take off his clothes and then has a nurse lick his genitals. Enjoy the feminine doctor and the large-breasted nurse in a story of turning the tables.​
translation: 手拿听诊器的女医生展开了一场场异乎寻常的诊疗检查。她命前来就诊的男子脱光衣服，随后更指使护士舔舐他的私处。在这场攻守逆转的故事中，尽情领略妩媚女医生与巨乳护士的诱人魅力吧。
